verdict.rationale: Loops docs show API/CLI/MCP support for creating and updating contacts, lists, and mailing lists (loops-docs-4, loops-docs-24, loops-docs-27, loops-docs-23), and segments are described as dynamic based on properties (loops-docs-16), but there's no documented endpoint or example for reading back exactly which contacts belong to a given segment/tag/list via the API. missing for 10: explicit API/CLI endpoint to list/query members of a specific segment or tag, documented tag CRUD operations, and independent confirmation that read-back matches exactly what was set.
